children: Geopolitical developments in Ukraine and the Middle East will continue to dictate markets as global oil supply tightens and inflation metrics trend higher.

The earnings season will also gather pace, with Meta and Tesla reporting the latest signals on the volatile AI trade, while results are also due from P&G, Netflix, GE Aerospace, SAP, and Texas Instruments.
On the economic data front, S&P PMIs across the US, Eurozone, Japan, Australia, and India will offer initial insights for October.
The US will also release key housing data.

In Europe, other sentiment surveys will draw attention, including Germany's ZEW and the European Commission economic sentiment indicator, while a busy week in the UK revolves around inflation and the labor market.
Elsewhere, China's monthly data dump will include Q3 GDP growth, and Japan will release its inflation and trade figures.
Canada will also publish its CPI.

title: Week Ahead - Oct 19th
